purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian beverage/consumer goods distribution – updates route information and calculates order suggestions for VDI (Vendas Diretas/Direct Sales) field sales representatives; called via PW00458S
purpose.summary: This program updates route and scheduling information for field sales order suggestion calculations for VDI sales reps. It processes products, combos, scheduled orders, PDV pricing, client routes, and last-sale data across numerous indexed work files. It is called as a subprogram from PW00458S and handles complex business logic including combo products, coverage actions, and price tables.

notable_features: REPOSITORY clause with OOP CLASS references
105 COPY statements indicating heavy copybook usage
Multiple indexed VSAM-style files with LOCK MODE IS MANUAL
ALTERNATE KEY with duplicates on indexed files
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 171660 bytes / 3355 lines. The $set directives and CLASS repository syntax are characteristic of GnuCOBOL with OOP extensions. The htmlpp preprocessor suggests use of the GnuCOBOL htmlpp tool. All identifiers and comments are in Brazilian Portuguese. The program is part of a larger suite (PW/PY/PC naming convention) typical of Brazilian ERP/distribution systems.
